title: Satya Nadella calls for an ‘emergency brake’ outside the AI model
friendlyTitle: Microsoft’s CEO says every AI system needs a stop button
summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella argues that organizations should treat capable models like insider risks: limit privileges, log meaningful actions and keep shutdown controls outside the model and its orchestration layer.
friendlySummary: Satya Nadella says companies should limit what AI can access, record what it does and make sure a person can stop it.
whyItMatters: This is a concrete architecture for safer business automation. Teams deploying agents should retain independent permissions, audit trails and a human-operated stop mechanism rather than relying on a model to police itself.
friendlyWhyItMatters: If your business uses AI agents, safety controls should sit outside the AI so the AI cannot change or ignore them.
